name: Bombinhas (Brazil)
description: Horizontal triband of yellow, green and yellow, charged at the centre with a blue disc bearing the municipal arms with a scroll reading BOMBINHAS.
history: Bombinhas is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 13 March 1995 (prescribed by Municipal Law No. 181 of 13 March 1995, the arms by Law No. 182 of the same year, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown, a boat and the sea, reading BOMBINHAS
